items.title: 社交清算
items.overview: 《社交网络》的延续作品，受真实事件启发。年轻的Facebook工程师弗朗西斯·豪根在《华尔街日报》记者杰夫·霍维茨的协助下，踏上一段危险的旅程，揭露这个社交网络最隐秘的内幕。

items.title: 编个丈夫
items.overview: 海边小镇里有一个身上散发臭味的打渔女，饱受狭隘的邻居嘲讽，而她为自己找了个柳条做成的丈夫。这段离经叛道的爱情在保守的小镇里引起了怒火、嫉妒和轩然大波。

items.title: 蜘蛛侠：崭新之日
items.overview: 《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》事件四年后，世界已经忘记了彼得·帕克的存在。他独自生活在纽约，将全部精力投入打击犯罪，成为一名全职蜘蛛侠。然而，看着昔日好友各自开启新的生活，长期的孤独与日益沉重的责任让彼得承受着巨大的压力，他的身体也开始发生难以控制的异常变化。与此同时，一名行踪难以察觉的强大敌人正悄然威胁着纽约及他所珍视的人。面对身体的异变与不断逼近的危机，彼得不得不独自迎接新的挑战……

profile.tagline: 纵使被遗忘，依然在守护。

items.title: 马登
items.overview: 基于真实故事，讲述脾气火爆的前NFL主教练约翰·马登在奥克兰突袭者队被迫退役后，与温文尔雅的哈佛程序员、艺电公司创始人特里普·霍金斯合作，通过打造世界上第一个橄榄球视频游戏来改写他日渐式微的资产。随后他步入体育解说界，为ABC、CBS、FOX、NBC等播出的橄榄球比赛担任解说员，延续传奇职业生涯。

items.title: 风雪同舟
items.overview: 两人因假日暴风雪导致航班停飞而被困机场，被迫共享一辆租车，横跨美国赶往纽约。途中出现路侧事故、意外绕路和小镇魅力，两人在一家汽车旅馆过夜，并在商场扮演圣诞老人和圣诞夫人。节日氛围缓和了两人激烈的对立关系。

items.title: 沙丘3
items.overview: 改编自弗兰克·赫伯特的科幻小说《沙丘2：沙丘救世主》。保罗·厄崔迪夺取帝国统治权近二十年后，成为冷酷的皇帝。面对旧盟友回归、新威胁浮现与暗中背叛，保罗深陷一场阴谋，并必须直面权力的代价与所爱之人的命运。

profile.tagline: 命运已至，终章降临。

items.overview: 当一支身份不明的敌军策划改变反对美国时，总统为了挽救自己的生命和美国的安危，揭露了“野兽”高度机密的进攻能力。

items.title: 完美骗子
items.overview: 茱德德里带着秘密任务踏入了精英贵族学校塔古斯大学，目标是打入卡什兄弟的圈子，查明她哥哥的死亡真相。一场始于复仇的行动，逐渐演变成由诱惑、禁忌吸引和谎言交织而成的危险三角博弈，将她推向一个她可能还没准备好面对的真相。本片改编自艾力克斯米雷茲的小说。

related.title: 特种空勤团：红色通缉令

items.title: 哥斯拉-0.0
items.overview: 人类的罪与罚。已经，没法归零。战争将日本粉碎至“零”，哥斯拉的袭击更将它推至“负”的绝境。时间来到两年后，人民历尽痛苦磨难仍坚持复苏的步伐，看似终于可以回归正常生活……然而此时，巨兽再次袭来。它彻底摧毁这份希望，将人类推向新的绝望深渊！

related.title: 战龙哥斯拉：怪兽总进击

items.title: 生化危机：爆发夜
items.overview: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？.

items.title: 拜见岳父大人4
items.overview: 格雷格·福克和帕姆·伯恩斯的儿子亨利已经长大成人，并决定与一位看似与他完全不合拍的女性奥利维亚·琼斯结婚。奥利维亚曾是一名FBI人质谈判专家。她自信地表示，这份职业经历让她完全有能力将亨利从被“情感绑架”的状态中“解救”出来。奥利维亚这种直率强势的性格让格雷格感到不安和不满。然而，前CIA特工杰克·伯恩斯——那位以严苛考验女婿闻名的岳父却因此对奥利维亚刮目相看，甚至欣赏她，并想邀请她加入家族的“信任圈”。

items.title: 我演洛奇
items.overview: 根据西尔维斯特·史泰龙真实经历改编。一位名不见经传的演员西尔维斯特·史泰龙坚信，自己不仅要编写《洛奇》的剧本，更要亲自出演洛奇·巴尔博亚。面对重重阻挠，他押上一切，坚持争取主角机会。

related.title: 自由主义者：间谍的时代

items.title: 峡湾
items.overview: 一对虔诚的罗马尼亚裔挪威夫妇带着五个孩子搬到挪威一座小镇，与邻居逐渐熟络。然而，当女儿带着不明伤痕出现在学校，夫妇二人因涉嫌虐待孩子而受到调查。

items.title: MobLand
items.overview: 两大黑帮家族的权力争斗将伦敦地下世界卷入战争。作为哈里根家族的“解决者”，哈里·达·索萨周旋于家族、敌人和日益失控的内部矛盾之间。

items.title: 指环王：力量之戒
items.original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
items.overview:
强大的力量锻造成型，王国辉煌崛起又陨落成尘，让人意想不到的英雄遭受考验，而强大的反派势要让整个世界蒙上黑暗。

一组为人熟悉的人物和全新的角色，他们必须对抗邪恶势力在中土世界再度崛起。从迷雾山脉的最深处、林顿壮丽的森林、努曼诺尔的海岛王国到地图的最边缘，这些领土和角色将联手创造传奇，即使他们不在人世后仍流芳百世。

本剧设定在托尔金的《霍比特人》和《指环王》事件前的数千年，将带领观众回到那个年代。

cast.name: 伊斯梅尔·克鲁斯·科尔多瓦

items.title: 罪蓝之路
items.overview: 两国接连发生带有神秘信息的残忍凶案，两名刑警联手追查真相，却浑然不觉致命真相不仅近在咫尺，而且暗藏危机。

items.title: 青春共体
items.overview: 万圣夜当晚，一场入队仪式沦为人间炼狱，天主教女子舞团因而陷入叛教的罪咎、不洁的欲望与鬼魅的幻影之中。

items.title: 幻视任务
items.overview: 重启后的幻视隐居避世，试图摆脱将他武器化的人，并通过与体内的AI人格交流寻找存在意义，其中包括恶名昭彰的奥创。然而高额悬赏打破了平静，他被迫与神秘少年托马斯·谢泼德一同逃亡，后者或许是他重生后的儿子。

items.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
items.overview: 波西·杰克逊正在执行一项危险的任务。他必须战胜怪物，智取众神，穿越美洲，归还宙斯的闪电权杖，并阻止一场全面战争。在任务搭档安娜贝丝和格洛弗的帮助下，波西的旅程将引导他更接近他所追寻的答案：如何融入他感觉格格不入的世界，以及他是否能弄清楚自己注定要成为什么样的人。

related.title: 加斯·马伦基的黑暗之地

items.title: 我的有罪之人
items.overview: 杀人案头号嫌疑人、泰江集团三代继承人尹伊俊，引来特种部队出身的刑警姜在熙。她女扮男装，伪装成贴身秘书潜入调查。在熙一边查案，一边与刻薄敏感的伊俊不断交锋，二人渐生情愫。

items.title: 嗜血法医：杀魔复生
items.overview: 迈阿密血迹分析师德克斯特·摩根以连环杀手为目标，在隐藏真实身份的同时，继续遵循自己的杀戮准则，并面对儿子哈里森及过往带来的种种纠葛。

profile.tagline: 他还活着，而且表现超神。

items.title: 黄蜂
items.overview: 这个项目融合了求生题材、恐怖故事以及成长故事等多种元素。故事的主角是一群才华横溢的高中女生足球队运动员。一场飞机失事之后，这群有着天赋的女孩子们成为了幸存者，试图在安大略省的山区里寻找新生。这是一个关于整个群体集体求生的故事，也将会观察她们在事故25年之后试图重新团结起来的生活。原来过去的事情并不会那样被轻易抹掉，而曾在山区里发生的事也远远没有结束。

related.title: 我知道你去年夏天干了什么

items.title: 银翼杀手2099
items.overview: 科拉曾是一名逃亡者，后成为"银翼杀手"；她与命不久矣的复制人奥尔文联手，在重获新生的洛杉矶城中追捕一名逃亡者。在此过程中，她们揭开了一个足以摧毁这座脆弱城市的真相。
一宗劫案，经历12个月密谋、12小时行动。盗贼若在12天内逃过法网，就会从此逍遥法外。故事横跨三条惊心动魄的时间线，一名联邦探员与一名职业罪犯在欧洲展开生死追逐。

items.title: 两京十五日
items.overview: 该剧改编自马伯庸的同名小说，讲述了大明洪熙元年，当朝太子朱瞻基必须在15天内跑完两千两百余里路，从南京赶至北京去拯救自己，拯救大明的历史传奇故事。

items.title: 罪兽之法
items.overview: 一名杀害儿童的罪犯即将出狱，在波兰又掀起恐慌，也让负责此案的调查人员与精神科医生之间再度爆发道德冲突。

items.overview: 拣选是第一部关于基督生平的多季电视连续剧，通过他影响的人的眼睛见证。

items.title: 航海王
items.overview: 拥有财富、名声、势力，拥有整个世界的海贼王 – 哥尔·D·罗杰，他在临刑前的一句话，让人们趋之若鹜奔向大海。“想要我的财宝吗？想要的话可以全部给你，去找吧！我把所有财宝都放在那里。”于是所有男子汉航向伟大的航路追逐梦想，世界开始迎接“大海贼时代”。

items.title: 七犬特攻：沙漠惊天
items.overview: 国际刑警精英特工哈立德（艾哈迈德·埃兹 饰）成功逮捕了国际神秘犯罪集团“七犬（7 Dogs）”的高层头目加利（卡里姆·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹 饰）。一年后，该集团再次抬头，并开始在跨国市场大肆分销一种名为“粉红女郎（Pink Lady）”的致命新型合成毒品。由于局势失控，哈立德被迫与被囚禁的加利达成一项极具风险的不信任合作，依靠加利对集团内部的了解来瓦解这个庞大的网络。两人在多名国际特工的协助下，辗转于沙特利雅得、上海、孟买、拉斯维加斯等多个国际大都市，在充满背叛、爆炸与暗杀的险境中与欧洲毒枭朱莉娅（莫妮卡·贝鲁奇 饰）及其他幕后势力展开殊死搏斗。

items.title: 喜欢了你一整个青春
items.overview: 高中联考失手的小爱被妈妈安排升读名校「一女中」的夜校部，但即使与日校生共享课室和书桌，成绩上的差距却总让小爱心存距离感，自卑感油然而生。幸好共享书桌的「桌友」敏敏没有因此嫌弃，两人更成为好友，甚至一同喜欢上隔壁学校的资优男生卢克。为了方便走堂，两人经常互换校服，但小爱渐渐舍不得日校生的制服光环，更使用冒牌的一女中身份，瞒着敏敏接近卢克，巨大的谎言坑洞最终变得一发不可收拾。《最乖巧的杀人犯》导演庄景燊延续台湾校园电影浪潮，由新生代演员主演，带领观众重修青春的成长课。

items.title: 二十四味
items.overview: 出国多年后回到故土的四月（袁澧林 饰），发现早已离异的父母重拾旧好，年少时她以极端自虐的方式挽留出轨父亲（钟镇涛 饰）的记忆再度浮现。凉茶铺正面临拆迁，四月要带巧珍（张艾嘉 饰）出国生活，巧珍却希望继续经营凉茶铺。重回家庭的落魄永堂默默为巧珍筹措重开凉茶铺的资金，拼尽全力却误中骗局。一团乱麻时，四月又遇野蛮生长、同父异母的妹妹小景。她将过去逃避的生活、时间以及自省一点点拾起。

items.title: 指尖谋杀
items.overview: 一次随手敲击，正在无声吞噬每个人。 　　一段被篡改的影像流传开来，铺天盖地的流言将当事人陈云舒（周依然 饰）推向社会性死亡，无差别围猎不断发酵。始料未及的突发事件层层叠加，反转频出，未婚夫王铮（梁靖康 饰）、检察官丁凡（周放 饰）、好友俞蓉（曾梦雪 饰）等等，越来越多的人被卷入，事态向着更加扑朔迷离的方向发展。受害者、加害者、旁观者、被牵连者，人人都拿着一把“指尖刀”，人人又都被“指尖刀”捅伤。是谁隐匿在黑暗中操控着这一切？真相又是什么？

items.title: 偷偷藏不住
items.overview: 暗恋这件事，偷偷藏不住。  　　桑稚青春里最隐秘的少女心事，是喜欢上哥哥桑延的大学室友段嘉许。这份因为年龄差距不敢言说的青涩暗恋，被小桑稚笨拙地藏了起来，不敢让任何人发现。  　　几年后再度重逢，桑稚长大成为明媚阳光的模样，而段嘉许也在相处中因她身上的光芒而心动。曾经悄无声息的喜欢，终于变成了彼此心照不宣的悸动……

items.title: 世界日出时
items.overview: 露西 —— 目前已知最早的人类祖先之一，被称为“人类祖母”。 　　研究生马科在潜心写作关于“露西”的语言学论文，他坚信露西拥有人类最早的语言能力。教授李彤表面质疑马科，实则在他的论文里找到了解释她女儿失踪的线索。 　　马科焦虑于现实和写作，此时妈妈海燕突然频繁出没在他的生活里。妈妈带领马科来到了她所购买的古朽老宅，通过这个神秘的屋子，妈妈的心事与心愿都在慢慢揭开，而马科的生活逐渐与论文中的世界不分彼此… 　　露西的身影浮现，人类祖母的呢喃声里，闪烁着爱的呼唤。

items.overview: 改编自拉尔斯·克卜勒的小说《拉撒路》和《睡魔》。恶名昭彰的连环杀手尤里克·沃尔特的一名受害者意外生还，警探乔纳·林分秒必争务求找出唯一仍然失踪的人，同时他的徒弟萨加·鲍尔则充当卧底，试图从杀手身上获得答案。

items.overview: 你大可以因为职业道德和曲解法律而对贾克斯·斯图尔特口诛笔伐，直到你自己遇上麻烦，那时你才会发现，她其实是洛杉矶最聪明、最无畏的辩护律师，凭一己之力对抗司法体系。

items.title: 换母疑云
items.overview: 桑尼在车祸后察觉母亲似乎已被冒牌者取代，却无人相信。他与朋友展开秘密调查，试图查明母亲身上发生的变化，并面对青春期的自我认同与亲子关系危机。

items.title: 对手
items.overview: 小说故事发生在虚构的上流社会拉特郡，德克兰·奥哈拉（艾丹·特纳饰）加入了残酷的科里尼姆电视台。他是一个魅力四射的正直明星，有一个光芒四射的花瓶妻子莫德（维多利亚·斯莫菲特饰）、一个英俊的儿子和两个迷人的十几岁的女儿（其中大女儿由贝拉·麦克莱恩饰演）。住在山谷对面的鲁伯特·坎贝尔-布莱克（阿历克斯·哈塞尔饰）是前奥运会选手、国会议员、臭名昭著的花花公子，曾离过婚，一如既往地放荡不羁，现在是保守党的体育部长。他的邻居即是他长期以来的竞争对手托尼·巴丁汉姆(大卫·田纳特饰)，科里尼姆电视台的总经理，他的妻子莫妮卡（克莱尔·拉什布鲁克饰）倒是对丈夫的工作毫无兴趣。托尼还有一个迷人的弟弟巴兹尔·巴斯·巴丁汉姆（卢克·帕斯夸尼诺饰），开了一家热门酒吧。德克兰在电视台工作不久就意识到托尼聘用他只是为了帮助电视台保留特许经营权。不仅如此，漂亮但专横的卡梅伦·库克（娜菲萨·威廉姆斯饰），这位才华横溢的美国电视高管，还被托尼带到科里尼姆，制作德克兰新的黄金时段脱口秀节目。德克兰和卡梅伦互相厌恶，引发了一场争论的风暴，鲁伯特以他一贯的方式投入其中。另一边，弗雷迪·琼斯（丹尼·戴尔饰）是一个白手起家的电子产品百万富翁。他得到了钱，却发现自己和妻子瓦莱丽(丽莎·麦格里斯饰)都是拉特希尔集团的局外人。正处于中年危机的副首相保罗·斯特拉顿（鲁弗斯·琼斯饰）的新婚妻子莎拉（艾米丽·阿塔克）野心勃勃，不害怕利用自己的外表达到顶峰。浪漫小说家莉齐·维克尔（凯瑟琳·帕金森饰）则一直被她爱打扮、以自我为中心的电视主持人丈夫詹姆斯·维克尔(奥利弗·克里斯饰)所忽视随着一个竞争对手的出现来为这部电影的专营权做宣传，名声的成熟和衰落，真爱的绽放和燃烧，婚姻的建立和破裂……在床上和会议室里，争夺科茨沃尔德王冠的比赛开始了。

items.title: 一杆入魂
items.overview: 普莱斯·卡希尔原本有望成为伟大的高尔夫球员，但因为一次在球场上情绪崩溃，而断送了他的职业生涯。现在，只能勉强维持生计的他，赌上一切指导一名潜力无限的少年天才桑提，同时也试图拯救自己。
一宗劫案，经历12个月密谋、12小时行动。盗贼若在12天内逃过法网，就会从此逍遥法外。故事横跨三条惊心动魄的时间线，一名联邦探员与一名职业罪犯在欧洲展开生死追逐。

items.title: 东区人
items.overview: 阿尔伯特广场（Albert Square）的工人阶级居民的日常生活，阿尔伯特广场是维多利亚时代的传统露台露台，周围环绕着伦敦沃尔福德区东端的一个公园。

items.title: 旺达在哪里？

items.title: 南方公园
items.overview: 讲述科罗拉多州南方公园小镇上，斯坦、凯尔、卡特曼和肯尼四个孩子的生活。他们不断卷入超自然事件、社会冲突和各种荒诞危机，并以孩子的视角面对成年人世界中的政治、宗教、文化和社会问题。

items.title: 独家黑幕
items.overview: 塔尔萨的公民记者李·雷本自称“真相守护者”，执着于揭露腐败与社会阴暗面。他不断追查各种事件背后的真相，即使因此身陷危险，也不愿停止调查。

items.overview: 金发瘪四与黑发大头蛋是一对正值青春期的死党，他们认为凡是只能归纳为两类，不是酷就是逊！这对荷尔蒙分泌过盛的宝贝并不笨，只是聪明没用对地方，他们满脑子想的都是怎样上马子，急欲摆脱处男之身的他们可以把任何事物都形容得“性“致勃勃，令人绝倒！本片缘起于瘪赐与大头蛋的电视遭窃，他们急著上天下海四处找寻，终于来到一煎破旅馆，遇到个叫曼迪的老粗。曼迪说他愿付一万元雇他们去洛杉矶“做“了他老婆，色欲薰心的瘪四与大头蛋一听，不禁喜出望外，殊不知此“做“非彼“做“！于是，他们欢天喜地的搭上往洛杉矶的飞机，展开他们的处男航（第一次搭飞机）。但到了洛杉矶，事情并不如他们所想像的，为了追上曼迪的前妻，瘪四与大头蛋始终周旋在两名联邦调查员和一群老人之间。

items.overview: 《蝙蝠交通工具 第一季》围绕着超级蝙蝠车团队展开，讲述了他们在守护高谭市过程中的一系列精彩故事。团队成员包括勇敢的班姆、特技高手小碧、匿踪科技专家红鸟、力量强大的巴夫和飞行能力者飞翼。在蝙蝠计算机比希和机动作业专家阿莫的协助下，他们保护着城市的和平。在这一季中，超级蝙蝠车团队遭遇了众多超级坏蛋带来的麻烦。小丑、企鹅、毒藤女、谜语大师等反派肆意妄为，给城市制造了诸多混乱。小丑偷走奖杯、用气球袭击庄园；企鹅抢夺燃料电池、控制小鸭船捣乱；毒藤女利用植物威胁城市；谜语大师则凭借各种阴谋诡计制造麻烦......面对这些危机，超级蝙蝠车团队从不退缩，他们在危机中成长，在困境中学会合作，在失败中汲取经验，最终不仅能成功解救高谭市，彼此的感情也更加深厚。

items.overview: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart. Suspended between love's salvation and fate's cruelty, Arafta is a saga of passion and payback, where every choice risks turning fire into ashes.

items.title: 海绵宝宝
items.overview: 海绵宝宝是一块穿着短裤衬衫打领带、暴牙大眼睛的黄色海绵，他生活在太平洋中央一片名为比基尼的海底之下。这里风和日丽，平静祥和，生活无忧无虑。海绵宝宝住在一个菠萝形状的房子里，与之为伴的是他的宠物小蜗（蜗牛）。开朗、纯真的海绵宝宝有许多好朋友，比如乐观单纯的派大星、性格古怪的章鱼哥、自私市侩的蟹老板还有力大无穷的松鼠珊蒂。平时他都在蟹老板的快餐店里打工，闲暇时就和好朋友们四处玩乐。这群性格各异的家伙们凑在一起，可真是闹出不少的笑话……本片为美国最受欢迎的电视系列动画之一，在 2003~2009 年期间，曾经 7 年当选美国儿童选择奖最受欢迎的动画片。

items.title: Honey
items.overview: Honey goes deep undercover in 1980s East Berlin to explore a shadowy world of counter espionage and risky but irresistible relations. East Berlin, 1982. Martha, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois. The risk of being garrotted or incarcerated is nothing compared to the horrifying ordeal of falling in love. Allowing yourself to be vulnerable and bearing your heart and soul? She'd rather have her fingernails ripped off.

items.title: 少年泰坦出击
items.overview:
本剧是 DC 经典动画《少年泰坦》的衍生喜剧作品。与前作偏重严肃动作的风格截然不同，本剧聚焦于罗宾（Robin）、星火（Starfire）、钢骨（Cyborg）、渡鸦（Raven）和野兽男孩（Beast Boy）这五位少年超级英雄在“不拯救世界”时的日常生活。

没有了成年人的监督，这些性格各异的青春期英雄们同住在泰坦塔里，闹出了各种啼笑皆非的笑话。从为了争夺电视遥控器而大打出手、疯狂迷恋某种垃圾食品，到应对各种奇葩的超级反派，他们的日常生活中充满了无厘头的幽默、自我恶搞以及对流行文化的疯狂致敬。这是一部轻松、跳脱且极具娱乐性的超级英雄日常喜剧。

items.title: The Chosen
items.overview: The Chosen is the first-ever-multi-season TV show about the life of Jesus. Created outside of the Hollywood system, The Chosen allows us to see Him through the eyes of those who knew him. No matter where you are at in your journey with Jesus Christ, this TV show is for you.

items.title: The Witch Farm
items.overview: South Wales, 1989. Bill and Liz Rich leave London for Heol Fanog, a remote modern farmhouse in the foothills of the Brecon Beacons, determined to make a fresh start. At first, the isolation feels like freedom. But when, in the midst of a traumatic home birth, Liz becomes convinced she's seen a ghostly figure in the bedroom they start to feel increasingly afraid…What follows is a steady escalation of the chillingly uncanny - unexplained disturbances and an unsettling sense that they are not alone. As Bill and Liz begin to investigate, the house draws them deeper into a history that refuses to stay buried. And as the land yields its secrets, so too does their marriage - testing the limits of trust, belief, and what they're willing to deny in order to survive.

items.title: City of God: The Fight Rages On
items.original_title: City of God: The Fight Rages On
items.overview: City of God: The Fight Rages On takes place two decades after the events of the highly acclaimed film "City of God." City of God: The Fight Rages On is an adapted continuation of the literary work by Paulo Lins, and will follow the story of its characters, starting with the work of the photographer Buscapé. Set in the early 2000s, the series includes excerpts from the film as flashbacks to reconstruct the protagonists' memories.

items.title: Overgeared
items.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

items.title: Mission: Yozakura Family
items.overview: High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

items.original_title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
items.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

items.title: Fool in Love
items.overview: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

items.title: Sram
items.overview: Following the lives of teenagers that attend high school, everyday issues of teenage life, such as friendships, romantic relationships and mental health.Croatian remake of the Norwegian series Skam

items.title: Taming the Husband
items.overview: Jin Bao Zhu, the spirited daughter of a butcher, has always harbored simple, materialistic dreams of wealth and comfort. Desperate to escape her oppressive family life, she volunteers to enter a prestigious canal transport family as the concubine of their son, Xie Yan. However, her dreams of luxury quickly shatter: while Xie Yan was once a brilliant prodigy, he has been left disabled and disgraced by a tragic accident. Xie Yan has become bitter and self-destructive and resents Bao Zhu, who he feels has been forced upon him. The marriage gets off to a rough start, as Xie Yan and Bao Zhu are constantly fighting. But as they navigate the treacherous political schemes surrounding the canal transport industry and fend off ambitious relatives, their mutual animosity slowly transforms. Can they find a way to work together to save their crumbling family legacy and their marriage?

items.title: Marshals
items.overview: Marshals stars Luke Grimes reprising his role as Kayce Dutton. With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana. Kayce and his teammates - Pete Calvin, Belle Skinner, Andrea Cruz and Miles Kittle - must balance the high psychological cost of serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence with their duty to their families, which for Kayce includes his son Tate and his confidants Thomas Rainwater and Mo from the Broken Rock reservation.

items.title: The Simpsons
items.overview: The Simpsons is the longest running scripted show in US television history. It captures the adventures of Homer, Marge, Maggie, Bart and Lisa who are living in a fictional town called Springfield.

items.title: Tracker
items.overview: Tracker features lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw, who roams the country as a "reward seeker," using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement to solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

items.title: The Institute
items.overview: When 12-year-old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won't last, as his story and Luke's are destined to collide.

items.title: The Gilded Age
items.overview: The American Gilded Age was a period of immense economic change, of huge fortunes made and lost, and the rise of disparity between old money and new.Against this backdrop of change, the story begins in 1882 — introducing young Marian Brook, the orphaned daughter of a Union general, who moves into the New York City home of her thoroughly old money aunts Agnes van Rhijn and Ada Brook. Accompanied by Peggy Scott, an accomplished African-American woman, Marian inadvertently becomes enmeshed in a social war between one of her aunts, a scion of the old money set, and her stupendously rich neighbors, a ruthless railroad tycoon and his ambitious wife, George and Bertha Russell.In this exciting new world that is on the brink of the modern age, will Marian follow the established rules of society, or forge her own path?

items.title: Miss Scarlet
items.overview: When Eliza's father dies, he leaves her penniless in a time where marriage is the only option for financial security. But the headstrong Eliza has an ace up her bonnet - her father's business, a detective agency. But it's Victorian London and, to operate in this man's world, she needs a partner.Step forward consummate rogue Detective Inspector William Wellington of Scotland Yard, aka "The Duke".Eliza and Duke strike up a fiery relationship as they team up to solve puzzling crimes in the murkiest depths of 1880s London.

items.overview: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

items.title: Grimsburg
items.overview: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack - his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute will follow every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know.

items.title: Universal Basic Guys
items.overview: In Universal Basic Guys brothers Mark and Hank Hoagies suddenly find themselves with no jobs when the Glantontown Hot Dog factory switches over to automation. Lucky for them, the town started a radical Universal Basic Income pilot program, giving all residents of Glantontown $3,000 per month with no strings attached. Now, Mark, Hank and the rest of their local buddies are once again kids in the summertime, overflowing with the perilous combo of free time and stupid ideas. This is a show about men trying to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

items.title: FBI
items.overview: FBI is a fast-paced drama about the inner workings of the New York Field Office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. These first-class agents, including Special Agent Maggie Bell and her partner, Special Agent Omar Adom 'OA' Zidan, bring all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep New York and the country safe.

items.title: CIA
items.overview: CIA centers on two unlikely partners — a fast-talking, rule-breaking loose cannon CIA case officer, and a by-the-book, seasoned and smart FBI agent who believes in the rule of law. When this odd couple are assigned to work out of CIA's New York Station, they must learn to work together to investigate cases and criminals posing threats on U.S. soil, finding that their differences may actually be their strength.

items.title: General Hospital
items.overview: General Hospital, which celebrated its golden anniversary on April 1, 2013, continues its tradition of passion, intrigue and adventure that takes place in the fictional town of Port Charles in upstate New York. The glamour and excitement of those who have come to find their destinies in this familiar seaport town intertwine with the lives, loves and fortunes of beloved, well-known faces. As always, love, danger and mind blowing plot twists continue to abound on General Hospital with contemporary storylines and unforgettable characters.

items.title: Beyond the Gates
items.overview: Beyond the Gates is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. Here you'll find a posh gated community with winding tree-lined streets and luxurious mansions to call home. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where our characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life … and some with more grace than others.

items.title: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン
items.overview:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

items.title: 装备我最强
items.overview:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)

items.original_title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
items.english_title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
items.overview:
Sato-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer.

Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat!

Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

items.title: ブラッククローバー 第2期
items.overview:
As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.title: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。　～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
items.original_title: Tsuihou Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka Suru.: Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
items.english_title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
items.overview:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.
Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.
The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.
Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.
This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!
(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)

items.title: 你好，我是受心上人所托来做恋爱药的魔女。
items.original_title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.
items.english_title: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
items.overview:
“Make me a love potion.”

And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

(Source: Yen Press)

items.title: 药屋少女的呢喃 第三季
items.overview:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district.

One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature.

Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation."

To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again.

From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.title: 转生哥布林有问题吗？
items.english_title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
items.overview:
Office worker Akira Yagami’s altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira’s newfound powers let him defy the species’ normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Tensei Goblin Dakedo Shitsumon Aru? is streaming 1 week in advance of the TV broadcast on ABEMA and Prime Video beginning with episode 2 on October 5th, 2026

items.title: アオのハコ Season２
items.overview:
The second season of Ao no Hako.

As Taiki and Chinatsu navigate their evolving feelings, a fractured friendship from the past and fierce competition cloud the road to nationals.

(Source: Netflix, edited)

items.title: 学生会也有洞！
items.original_title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
items.english_title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
items.overview:
This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.

High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards.
However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students!

(Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)

items.title: 目覚めたら最強装備と宇宙船持ちだったので、一戸建て目指して傭兵として自由に生きたい
items.original_title: Mezametara Saikyou Soubi to Uchuusen-mochi datta node, Ikkodate Mezashite Youhei to shite Jiyuu ni Ikitai
items.english_title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
items.overview:
Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

items.title: 和没有信徒的女神大人一起攻略异世界
items.original_title: Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku
items.english_title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
items.overview:
RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

items.title: 超巡！超条前辈
items.overview:
The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.title: 萤火虫的出嫁
items.overview:
On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

(Source: VIZ Media)

items.title: サイバーパンク: エッジランナーズ2
items.overview:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 pulls you back into Night City, where lives become entangled to the extreme. Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found. Across this ten-episode standalone series, uncover a story of family, obsession, legacy — and how your lens reflects the stories of the people around you..

When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?
(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site, Official Twitter)

items.title: 転生貴族、鑑定スキルで成り上がる 第3期
items.original_title: Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season
items.english_title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3
items.overview:
The third season of Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru.

Note: On September 4, 2026, it was announced that GeyeG Pictures would take over the production from studio MOTHER while keeping the same staff.

items.title: アオアシ 第2期
items.overview:
Aoi Ashito’s game has now earned him a spot on the A team, but he is quickly overwhelmed by his harsh new reality. Surrounded by elite players like Kuribayashi and Akutsu, practices are just as merciless as the matches. In this U-18 Premier League of powerhouse talent, Ashito must evolve or be crushed, if he’s ever to be acknowledged.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.title: 龙珠超 比鲁斯
items.overview:
Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep.
Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.
Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

(Source: Official Site)

Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.

items.title: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 スティール・ボール・ラン 2nd＆3rd STAGE
items.original_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Steel Ball Run - 2nd & 3rd STAGE
items.english_title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd - 3rd STAGE
items.overview:
In the 2nd STAGE, a desert crossing spanning roughly 750 miles- the land that Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli must challenge, is home to the area that is feared as the "Devil's Palm." In 1875, a threat lurking in said desert wiped out a cavalry of 26 people, eliciting fear from the local native people. As ominous incidents begin to unfold, they are forced to realize that this race is far more than a mere competition. The two press forward, where countless hidden motives collide..

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime, Netflix Anime, edited)

items.title: 黑暗召唤师在地下恋爱中
items.overview:
Amona’s a dark summoner with demonic powers. Roni’s a devout priest who’s way too uptight. By all rights, they should hate each other. Instead, they end up fast-tracking their enemies-to-lovers arc with a one-night stand that somehow insists on becoming a recurring event. Now they must hide their situationship from the rest of the party while denying their growing attraction to one another, all while dealing with an imp who’s far too invested in their love life.

(Source: HIDIVE)

items.title: 用【循环利息】强制收回借出的魔力
items.original_title: Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu
items.english_title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
items.overview:
If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out?

Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!
(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

items.title: マジカル★エクスプローラー　エロゲの友人キャラに転生したけど、ゲーム知識使って自由に生きる
items.original_title: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru
items.overview:
Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Each episode streamed 1 week early on ABEMA and d anime store. The original TV broadcast started on October 4th, 2026.

items.title: 冰之城墙 第二季
items.overview:
Koyuki, the isolated girl; Miki, the former school idol; Minato, the guy with no concept of personal space; and Youta, the gentle basketball player. Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on.

As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by… 

(Source: Netflix)

items.english_title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 2
items.overview: The second season of Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta!

items.english_title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc
items.overview: Sequel to Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku-hen.

items.title: 転生したら剣でした 第2期
items.overview:
The second season of Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita.
Note: Each episode was streamed one week in advance of the TV broadcast starting on October 1, 2026 on Abema. Regular broadcasting began on October 8, 2026.

items.title: 极致软弱千金小姐，不小心答应了精明未婚夫的赌局
items.original_title: Yowaki MAX Reijou Nano ni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta
items.english_title: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé
items.overview:
I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game. 

After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum and then become a curator.

So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son.

But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily?

items.title: 幻想水浒传
items.overview:
Riliu and Jowy have always fought side by side, dreaming of a future beyond the battlefield. But when war engulfs the Highland Kingdom, the childhood friends are swept into a struggle far greater than themselves. As the 108 Stars of Destiny begin to gather, the boys must face a conflict that will challenge their beliefs and put their friendship to the test.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~50 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

items.title: ロメリア戦記 〜魔王を倒した後も人類やばそうだから軍隊組織した〜
items.original_title: Romelia Senki: Maou wo Taoshita nochi mo Jinrui Yabasou dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita
items.overview:
Romelia and her party succeed in defeating the Demon King Zelgis, though Prince Henri’s reckless charge forces them into a grueling battle. In the aftermath, Romelia is branded "dead weight" for not fighting directly, and the Prince unilaterally breaks off their engagement. Denied a place in the victory celebrations, Romelia returns home, only to be met with cold indifference from her family and society. Yet, she refuses to break. She has already set her sights on the path that lies ahead.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: Romelia War Chronicle streamed 2 days in advance of the TV broadcast on AnimeTimes, U-NEXT, and Netflix beginning October 3, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on October 5, 2026.

items.original_title: Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka Part 2

items.overview: The second part of Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka.

items.overview: 克里斯托弗·诺兰将荷马笔下的怪物搬上银幕，打造了一部在全球多地取景拍摄的神话动作史诗。这是一场无与伦比的电影盛事。[环球影业]

profile.tagline: 违抗神明，逆天而行。

items.title: 守护你，遇见爱
items.overview: 一名不苟言笑的保镖奉命在假期保护一位魅力四射的动作明星，结果两人擦出火花，秘密接连曝光，圣诞节也变得异常复杂。

creators.name: 伊丽莎白·艾伦·罗森鲍姆

items.overview: 改编自苏珊·柯林斯的同名小说。故事发生在《饥饿游戏》事件发生前24年，讲述第50届饥饿游戏（第二次四分区叛乱纪念赛）抽签日当天，年轻的黑密斯·阿伯纳西被选中参赛的故事。

related.title: 饥饿游戏：鸣鸟与蛇之歌

items.title: 野兽之心
items.overview: 一名前陆军特种部队士兵与他退役战犬在阿拉斯加深处遭遇坠机事故后，这对老搭档必须在环境严酷的极地荒野中相互扶持，为生存而战。

profile.tagline: 生死相依，绝境求生

items.title: 风雪同舟
items.overview: 两人因假日暴风雪导致航班停飞而被困机场，被迫共享一辆租车，横跨美国赶往纽约。途中出现路侧事故、意外绕路和小镇魅力，两人在一家汽车旅馆过夜，并在商场扮演圣诞老人和圣诞夫人。节日氛围缓和了两人激烈的对立关系。

items.title: 生化危机：爆发夜
items.overview: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？.

items.title: 蜘蛛侠：崭新之日
items.overview: 《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》事件四年后，世界已经忘记了彼得·帕克的存在。他独自生活在纽约，将全部精力投入打击犯罪，成为一名全职蜘蛛侠。然而，看着昔日好友各自开启新的生活，长期的孤独与日益沉重的责任让彼得承受着巨大的压力，他的身体也开始发生难以控制的异常变化。与此同时，一名行踪难以察觉的强大敌人正悄然威胁着纽约及他所珍视的人。面对身体的异变与不断逼近的危机，彼得不得不独自迎接新的挑战……

profile.tagline: 纵使被遗忘，依然在守护。

items.title: 饥饿游戏
items.overview: 北美洲在一场大战后被摧毁，在美国原来的废墟上，人们建立了新的家园，但新政权规定：管辖下的12个地区每年都必须进贡少年男女，参加一档电视直播节目“饥饿游戏”。节目的规则很简单——杀人或者被杀。凯妮丝的妹妹不幸在12区“选择日”时被选中，由于要保护妹妹，凯妮丝自告奋勇要替妹妹上场 。她不得不与心上人盖尔分开，跟同时被选为12区贡品代表的皮塔进入游戏。尽管凯妮丝自小就进行狩猎，拥有过人的弓箭技巧，对节目里的重重障碍都能应付自如，但她在比赛中要与残忍强壮的他区选手互相周旋，要想成为最后的赢家就必须成为一个没有人性的杀人机器，这对她是一个极大的考验……

profile.tagline: 愿好运永远与你相伴

related.title: 饥饿游戏：鸣鸟与蛇之歌

items.title: 饥饿游戏2：星火燎原
items.overview: 第七十四届饥饿游戏已经结束，凯特尼斯出人意料地活了下来，她和“恋人”皮塔将会过上安定闲适的生活。然而，噩梦才刚刚开始，此时，十二个区也暗波涌动，凯特尼斯竟然成了反叛的象征，情窦初开的凯特尼斯陷入爱情的纠结中不能自拔，狩猎伙伴盖尔和竞技场“恋人”皮塔让她难以取舍盖尔和皮塔都深爱着凯特尼斯，为了不让凯特尼斯痛苦，他们不约而同地冷落疏远她。第七十五届饥饿游戏“世纪极限赛”的赛制是，选手是历届获胜者，他们中只有一人能存活。凯特尼斯又将重返杀戮赛场，凯特尼斯没有未来，她只有一死，才能挽救皮塔，这是对皮塔深情的最后报答，爱情与友谊，真诚与猜忌，血腥与牺牲，越来越扑朔迷离……

profile.tagline: 革命总是起于星星之火

items.title: 社交清算
items.overview: 《社交网络》的延续作品，受真实事件启发。年轻的Facebook工程师弗朗西斯·豪根在《华尔街日报》记者杰夫·霍维茨的协助下，踏上一段危险的旅程，揭露这个社交网络最隐秘的内幕。

profile.tagline: 1人吹哨，单挑网络帝国；1场起义，曝光操控30亿用户黑幕。

items.title: 童话继姊妹
items.overview: 在这部别具一格、妙趣横生的动作喜剧中，灰姑娘的“邪恶”继姐利莉思偷走了仙女教母昀魔杖，彻底颠覆了我们熟知的童话故事。

items.title: 饥饿游戏：鸣鸟与蛇之歌
items.original_title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
items.overview: 18岁的科里奥兰纳斯·斯诺被选为第十届饥饿游戏的导师，与来自第十二区的贫困女孩露西·格雷·贝尔德成为了“生死相依”的命运共同体。竞技场上，这是一场关乎自由、食物，甚至是尊重与权利的生死角逐；竞技场外，不忍与善意使斯诺决定不顾一切帮助露西在这场游戏中赢得胜利......当活下去的欲望与所遵守的规则背道而驰，命运的齿轮紧抓入自己手中时，他又该如何抉择？

profile.tagline: 残酷炼狱 绝境求生

items.title: 饥饿游戏3：嘲笑鸟（上）
items.overview: 凯特尼斯·伊夫狄恩，燃烧的女孩，虽然她的家被毁了，可她却活了下来。盖尔也逃了出来，凯特尼斯的家人也安全了，皮塔被凯匹特抓走了。十三区并不真的存在，出现了反抗，出现了新的领导者，一个革命的序幕正在缓缓拉开。凯特尼斯从噩梦般的竞技场逃出来是已经设计好的，她是反抗运动的参与者，也是设计好的，而她对此并不知情。十三区从隐蔽处出来了，并计划推翻凯匹特的统治。似乎每个人都参与了这项精心策划的行动，而只有凯特尼斯并不知情。反抗运动将凯特尼斯卷入了漩涡，她被迫成为棋子，她被迫为许多人的使命负责，不得不肩负起改变帕纳姆国的未来的负责。为了做到这一切，她必须抛却愤怒和不信任，她必须要成为反抗者的嘲笑鸟――不管要付出多大的代价。

items.title: 法警小队
items.overview: 《黄石》衍生剧。凯西·达顿加入美国法警局精英小队，运用牛仔与海豹突击队员的双重技能，打击蒙大拿州的暴力犯罪。在守护家人与履行职责之间，他和队友必须面对执法工作的沉重代价。

items.title: 指环王：力量之戒
items.original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
items.overview:
强大的力量锻造成型，王国辉煌崛起又陨落成尘，让人意想不到的英雄遭受考验，而强大的反派势要让整个世界蒙上黑暗。

一组为人熟悉的人物和全新的角色，他们必须对抗邪恶势力在中土世界再度崛起。从迷雾山脉的最深处、林顿壮丽的森林、努曼诺尔的海岛王国到地图的最边缘，这些领土和角色将联手创造传奇，即使他们不在人世后仍流芳百世。

本剧设定在托尔金的《霍比特人》和《指环王》事件前的数千年，将带领观众回到那个年代。

items.title: 寻踪者
items.overview: 改编自杰弗里·迪弗的畅销小说《The Never Game》。科尔特·肖是一名独行生存专家，游走各地寻找失踪者并领取悬赏。他凭借敏锐直觉、特殊技能和团队协助，调查危险案件、揭开隐藏真相，为陷入困境的人带来答案。

items.title: 嗜血法医：杀魔复生

items.title: 镀金时代
items.overview: 年轻的玛丽安·布鲁克从宾州乡下搬到纽约继承大量遗产的姑姑家，并不经意地被卷入了姑姑与富豪邻居的镀金时代社交争斗中。

items.title: 塔尔萨之王
items.overview: 纽约黑手党头目德怀特·曼弗雷迪服刑25年后获释，却被组织放逐至俄克拉何马州塔尔萨。他逐步招募一群意想不到的伙伴，在这座陌生城市建立自己的犯罪帝国。

items.title: 幻视任务
items.overview: 重启后的幻视隐居避世，试图摆脱将他武器化的人，并通过与体内的AI人格交流寻找存在意义，其中包括恶名昭彰的奥创。然而高额悬赏打破了平静，他被迫与神秘少年托马斯·谢泼德一同逃亡，后者或许是他重生后的儿子。

items.title: 青春共体
items.overview: 万圣夜当晚，一场入队仪式沦为人间炼狱，天主教女子舞团因而陷入叛教的罪咎、不洁的欲望与鬼魅的幻影之中。

items.title: 辛普森一家
items.overview: 辛普森一家是来自美国普通的五口之家，荷马是春田镇核能工厂的安全检查员，母亲马芝曾经是一个很有思想的女性，自从嫁给荷马后渐渐地适应了主妇生活的定式。巴特是家中的长子，天性顽皮的巴特经常爱玩一些恶作剧，以至于经常惹麻烦。妹妹丽莎是一个很聪明的孩子，同时还是素食主义者，佛教徒，爵士乐。小女马姬是一个永远长不大的孩子。故事设定于虚构小镇春田镇，从许多角度对美国的文化与社会、人的条件和电视本身进行了幽默的嘲讽，经久不衰。

items.title: 实习医生格蕾
items.overview: 西雅图格雷斯医院迎来新一批实习生，梅雷迪斯·格雷、克里斯蒂娜·杨、伊泽贝尔·斯蒂文、乔治·梅利 、亚里克斯·卡莱，五个医学院好友同期毕业，需要以良好表现争夺住院医师正式席位。进入医院伊始，梅雷迪斯崩溃地发现前晚在酒吧和她发生一夜情的男人，竟然是神经外科医生德立克·舍伯，两人纠葛就此开始；克里斯蒂娜吸引了胸外科医师普雷斯顿·伯克的注意，因为他们同样高傲和野心勃勃；乔治悄悄爱着梅雷迪斯；美丽的伊泽贝尔第一时间掀起流言，一年的实习期注定充满高密度的压力竞争与荷尔蒙……

items.title: 黄蜂
items.overview: 这个项目融合了求生题材、恐怖故事以及成长故事等多种元素。故事的主角是一群才华横溢的高中女生足球队运动员。一场飞机失事之后，这群有着天赋的女孩子们成为了幸存者，试图在安大略省的山区里寻找新生。这是一个关于整个群体集体求生的故事，也将会观察她们在事故25年之后试图重新团结起来的生活。原来过去的事情并不会那样被轻易抹掉，而曾在山区里发生的事也远远没有结束。

items.title: 饥饿游戏
items.overview: 北美洲在一场大战后被摧毁，在美国原来的废墟上，人们建立了新的家园，但新政权规定：管辖下的12个地区每年都必须进贡少年男女，参加一档电视直播节目“饥饿游戏”。节目的规则很简单——杀人或者被杀。凯妮丝的妹妹不幸在12区“选择日”时被选中，由于要保护妹妹，凯妮丝自告奋勇要替妹妹上场 。她不得不与心上人盖尔分开，跟同时被选为12区贡品代表的皮塔进入游戏。尽管凯妮丝自小就进行狩猎，拥有过人的弓箭技巧，对节目里的重重障碍都能应付自如，但她在比赛中要与残忍强壮的他区选手互相周旋，要想成为最后的赢家就必须成为一个没有人性的杀人机器，这对她是一个极大的考验……

tmdb-tv-308007.overview: 在这个取材于真实诈骗案的有毒爱情故事中，理想主义的年轻人突然间坐拥亿万身家，而本欲行善的他们却释放出彼此最丑恶的一面。

tmdb-tv-171802.title: 银翼杀手2099
tmdb-tv-171802.overview: 科拉曾是一名逃亡者，后成为"银翼杀手"；她与命不久矣的复制人奥尔文联手，在重获新生的洛杉矶城中追捕一名逃亡者。在此过程中，她们揭开了一个足以摧毁这座脆弱城市的真相。

tmdb-tv-254630.overview: 一宗劫案，经历12个月密谋、12小时行动。盗贼若在12天内逃过法网，就会从此逍遥法外。故事横跨三条惊心动魄的时间线，一名联邦探员与一名职业罪犯在欧洲展开生死追逐。

tmdb-tv-203483.title: 两京十五日
tmdb-tv-203483.overview: 该剧改编自马伯庸的同名小说，讲述了大明洪熙元年，当朝太子朱瞻基必须在15天内跑完两千两百余里路，从南京赶至北京去拯救自己，拯救大明的历史传奇故事。

tmdb-tv-332839.overview: 一名杀害儿童的罪犯即将出狱，在波兰又掀起恐慌，也让负责此案的调查人员与精神科医生之间再度爆发道德冲突。

tmdb-tv-279246.overview: 深受爱戴的皇后娜菲尔，与皇帝索本修一同治理着东大帝国。当索本修爱上逃亡奴隶菈丝塔，并要求与娜菲尔离婚时，娜菲尔答应了，但提出一个条件，她必须获得再婚许可，嫁给西王国王子海因里。

tmdb-tv-96677.title: Lupin
tmdb-tv-96677.overview: 灵感源自莫里斯·勒布朗创作的亚森·罗宾系列小说。绅士怪盗阿桑·迪奥普受到亚森·罗宾冒险的启发，凭借智慧与魅力智胜敌人，保护所爱之人。

tmdb-tv-37854.title: 航海王
tmdb-tv-37854.overview: 拥有财富、名声、势力，拥有整个世界的海贼王 – 哥尔·D·罗杰，他在临刑前的一句话，让人们趋之若鹜奔向大海。“想要我的财宝吗？想要的话可以全部给你，去找吧！我把所有财宝都放在那里。”于是所有男子汉航向伟大的航路追逐梦想，世界开始迎接“大海贼时代”。

tmdb-tv-79481.title: 斗破苍穹
tmdb-tv-79481.overview:
萧炎曾是家族里公认的斗气天才，年仅11岁便已经抵达了常人穷尽一生都无法修炼到的境界。可12岁那年，一场意外让萧炎的全部努力都化为了乌有，失去一切的他体会到了人情的冷暖和世态的炎凉，之后，萧炎和纳兰嫣然许下了决斗的三年之约，来到魔兽山脉，在身世神秘的药老手下修炼。三年间，萧炎的身影穿梭在塔戈尔大沙漠和加玛帝国黑岩城等地，结识了云芝、小医仙等志同道合的好友，并且最终获得了强大的力量。三年一晃眼就过去了，萧炎毫无悬念的战胜了纳兰嫣然，却没想到，他的故事和劫难才刚刚开始。

tmdb-movie-1376400.title: 蛛楼
tmdb-movie-1376400.overview: 一种剧毒蜘蛛入侵高层公寓，警方紧急封锁整栋大楼，住户全部被困。公寓管理员赛琳娜熟悉楼宇每一处通道，但她本身极度惧怕蜘蛛。毒虫不断增殖，在墙体与管道间四处猎捕幸存者，她只能凭借对大楼的了解，带领居民在封闭牢笼里拼死求生。

tmdb-movie-1720486.title: 史迪奇抓喵喵
tmdb-movie-1720486.overview: 故事设定在2002年原作之后：史迪奇终于在新家庭中过上了幸福安稳的日子，直到莉萝带回家一位新成员——一只粉色的外星小猫喵喵琦。这位新成员捣乱成性、光芒四射，无孔不入地渗透进史迪奇的生活，把他的整个世界搅了个天翻地覆。

tmdb-movie-1100099.title: 时间里的爱人
tmdb-movie-1100099.overview: 阿尔穆特与托比亚斯因一次意外相遇，人生从此改变。两人相恋、组建家庭，在时间的考验与生活的变故中，学会珍惜彼此相伴的每一刻。

tmdb-movie-1316427.title: 七犬特攻：沙漠惊天
tmdb-movie-1316427.overview: 国际刑警精英特工哈立德（艾哈迈德·埃兹 饰）成功逮捕了国际神秘犯罪集团“七犬（7 Dogs）”的高层头目加利（卡里姆·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹 饰）。一年后，该集团再次抬头，并开始在跨国市场大肆分销一种名为“粉红女郎（Pink Lady）”的致命新型合成毒品。由于局势失控，哈立德被迫与被囚禁的加利达成一项极具风险的不信任合作，依靠加利对集团内部的了解来瓦解这个庞大的网络。两人在多名国际特工的协助下，辗转于沙特利雅得、上海、孟买、拉斯维加斯等多个国际大都市，在充满背叛、爆炸与暗杀的险境中与欧洲毒枭朱莉娅（莫妮卡·贝鲁奇 饰）及其他幕后势力展开殊死搏斗。

tmdb-movie-1335881.title: 喜欢了你一整个青春
tmdb-movie-1335881.overview: 高中联考失手的小爱被妈妈安排升读名校「一女中」的夜校部，但即使与日校生共享课室和书桌，成绩上的差距却总让小爱心存距离感，自卑感油然而生。幸好共享书桌的「桌友」敏敏没有因此嫌弃，两人更成为好友，甚至一同喜欢上隔壁学校的资优男生卢克。为了方便走堂，两人经常互换校服，但小爱渐渐舍不得日校生的制服光环，更使用冒牌的一女中身份，瞒着敏敏接近卢克，巨大的谎言坑洞最终变得一发不可收拾。《最乖巧的杀人犯》导演庄景燊延续台湾校园电影浪潮，由新生代演员主演，带领观众重修青春的成长课。

tmdb-movie-1817684.title: 孤楼夜幽灵
tmdb-movie-1817684.overview: 女子林欣因一次意外而丧失记忆，雨夜，别墅里发生诡异事件，女儿失踪。二十年过去，林欣恢复记忆，再次回到女儿失踪的地方，找到女儿，揭开了二十年前发生在母女亲情背后的真相。

tmdb-movie-1502116.title: 二十四味
tmdb-movie-1502116.overview: 出国多年后回到故土的四月（袁澧林 饰），发现早已离异的父母重拾旧好，年少时她以极端自虐的方式挽留出轨父亲（钟镇涛 饰）的记忆再度浮现。凉茶铺正面临拆迁，四月要带巧珍（张艾嘉 饰）出国生活，巧珍却希望继续经营凉茶铺。重回家庭的落魄永堂默默为巧珍筹措重开凉茶铺的资金，拼尽全力却误中骗局。一团乱麻时，四月又遇野蛮生长、同父异母的妹妹小景。她将过去逃避的生活、时间以及自省一点点拾起。

tmdb-movie-1650345.title: 指尖谋杀
tmdb-movie-1650345.overview: 一次随手敲击，正在无声吞噬每个人。 　　一段被篡改的影像流传开来，铺天盖地的流言将当事人陈云舒（周依然 饰）推向社会性死亡，无差别围猎不断发酵。始料未及的突发事件层层叠加，反转频出，未婚夫王铮（梁靖康 饰）、检察官丁凡（周放 饰）、好友俞蓉（曾梦雪 饰）等等，越来越多的人被卷入，事态向着更加扑朔迷离的方向发展。受害者、加害者、旁观者、被牵连者，人人都拿着一把“指尖刀”，人人又都被“指尖刀”捅伤。是谁隐匿在黑暗中操控着这一切？真相又是什么？

tmdb-movie-1609560.title: 偷偷藏不住
tmdb-movie-1609560.overview: 暗恋这件事，偷偷藏不住。  　　桑稚青春里最隐秘的少女心事，是喜欢上哥哥桑延的大学室友段嘉许。这份因为年龄差距不敢言说的青涩暗恋，被小桑稚笨拙地藏了起来，不敢让任何人发现。  　　几年后再度重逢，桑稚长大成为明媚阳光的模样，而段嘉许也在相处中因她身上的光芒而心动。曾经悄无声息的喜欢，终于变成了彼此心照不宣的悸动……

tmdb-movie-1314764.title: 世界日出时
tmdb-movie-1314764.overview: 露西 —— 目前已知最早的人类祖先之一，被称为“人类祖母”。 　　研究生马科在潜心写作关于“露西”的语言学论文，他坚信露西拥有人类最早的语言能力。教授李彤表面质疑马科，实则在他的论文里找到了解释她女儿失踪的线索。 　　马科焦虑于现实和写作，此时妈妈海燕突然频繁出没在他的生活里。妈妈带领马科来到了她所购买的古朽老宅，通过这个神秘的屋子，妈妈的心事与心愿都在慢慢揭开，而马科的生活逐渐与论文中的世界不分彼此… 　　露西的身影浮现，人类祖母的呢喃声里，闪烁着爱的呼唤。

tmdb-tv-292741.title: 夜曲
tmdb-tv-292741.overview: 改编自拉尔斯·克卜勒的小说《拉撒路》和《睡魔》。恶名昭彰的连环杀手尤里克·沃尔特的一名受害者意外生还，警探乔纳·林分秒必争务求找出唯一仍然失踪的人，同时他的徒弟萨加·鲍尔则充当卧底，试图从杀手身上获得答案。

tmdb-tv-205272.title: 律界狂花
tmdb-tv-205272.overview: 你大可以因为职业道德和曲解法律而对贾克斯·斯图尔特口诛笔伐，直到你自己遇上麻烦，那时你才会发现，她其实是洛杉矶最聪明、最无畏的辩护律师，凭一己之力对抗司法体系。

tmdb-tv-275139.title: 换母疑云
tmdb-tv-275139.overview: 桑尼在车祸后察觉母亲似乎已被冒牌者取代，却无人相信。他与朋友展开秘密调查，试图查明母亲身上发生的变化，并面对青春期的自我认同与亲子关系危机。

tmdb-tv-208921.title: 对手
tmdb-tv-208921.overview: 小说故事发生在虚构的上流社会拉特郡，德克兰·奥哈拉（艾丹·特纳饰）加入了残酷的科里尼姆电视台。他是一个魅力四射的正直明星，有一个光芒四射的花瓶妻子莫德（维多利亚·斯莫菲特饰）、一个英俊的儿子和两个迷人的十几岁的女儿（其中大女儿由贝拉·麦克莱恩饰演）。住在山谷对面的鲁伯特·坎贝尔-布莱克（阿历克斯·哈塞尔饰）是前奥运会选手、国会议员、臭名昭著的花花公子，曾离过婚，一如既往地放荡不羁，现在是保守党的体育部长。他的邻居即是他长期以来的竞争对手托尼·巴丁汉姆(大卫·田纳特饰)，科里尼姆电视台的总经理，他的妻子莫妮卡（克莱尔·拉什布鲁克饰）倒是对丈夫的工作毫无兴趣。托尼还有一个迷人的弟弟巴兹尔·巴斯·巴丁汉姆（卢克·帕斯夸尼诺饰），开了一家热门酒吧。德克兰在电视台工作不久就意识到托尼聘用他只是为了帮助电视台保留特许经营权。不仅如此，漂亮但专横的卡梅伦·库克（娜菲萨·威廉姆斯饰），这位才华横溢的美国电视高管，还被托尼带到科里尼姆，制作德克兰新的黄金时段脱口秀节目。德克兰和卡梅伦互相厌恶，引发了一场争论的风暴，鲁伯特以他一贯的方式投入其中。另一边，弗雷迪·琼斯（丹尼·戴尔饰）是一个白手起家的电子产品百万富翁。他得到了钱，却发现自己和妻子瓦莱丽(丽莎·麦格里斯饰)都是拉特希尔集团的局外人。正处于中年危机的副首相保罗·斯特拉顿（鲁弗斯·琼斯饰）的新婚妻子莎拉（艾米丽·阿塔克）野心勃勃，不害怕利用自己的外表达到顶峰。浪漫小说家莉齐·维克尔（凯瑟琳·帕金森饰）则一直被她爱打扮、以自我为中心的电视主持人丈夫詹姆斯·维克尔(奥利弗·克里斯饰)所忽视随着一个竞争对手的出现来为这部电影的专营权做宣传，名声的成熟和衰落，真爱的绽放和燃烧，婚姻的建立和破裂……在床上和会议室里，争夺科茨沃尔德王冠的比赛开始了。

tmdb-tv-248830.title: 一杆入魂
tmdb-tv-248830.overview: 普莱斯·卡希尔原本有望成为伟大的高尔夫球员，但因为一次在球场上情绪崩溃，而断送了他的职业生涯。现在，只能勉强维持生计的他，赌上一切指导一名潜力无限的少年天才桑提，同时也试图拯救自己。

tmdb-tv-1871.title: 东区人
tmdb-tv-1871.overview: 阿尔伯特广场（Albert Square）的工人阶级居民的日常生活，阿尔伯特广场是维多利亚时代的传统露台露台，周围环绕着伦敦沃尔福德区东端的一个公园。

tmdb-tv-234310.title: 旺达在哪里？
tmdb-tv-234310.overview: 克拉特夫妇因女儿失踪之后化身业余侦探，开始秘密监视邻居。结果在业余监视期间，他们发现一个又一个惊人的秘密。

tmdb-tv-2190.title: 南方公园
tmdb-tv-2190.overview: 讲述科罗拉多州南方公园小镇上，斯坦、凯尔、卡特曼和肯尼四个孩子的生活。他们不断卷入超自然事件、社会冲突和各种荒诞危机，并以孩子的视角面对成年人世界中的政治、宗教、文化和社会问题。

tmdb-tv-273247.title: 独家黑幕
tmdb-tv-273247.overview: 塔尔萨的公民记者李·雷本自称“真相守护者”，执着于揭露腐败与社会阴暗面。他不断追查各种事件背后的真相，即使因此身陷危险，也不愿停止调查。

tmdb-tv-203489.title: 瘪四与大头蛋
tmdb-tv-203489.overview: 金发瘪四与黑发大头蛋是一对正值青春期的死党，他们认为凡是只能归纳为两类，不是酷就是逊！这对荷尔蒙分泌过盛的宝贝并不笨，只是聪明没用对地方，他们满脑子想的都是怎样上马子，急欲摆脱处男之身的他们可以把任何事物都形容得“性“致勃勃，令人绝倒！本片缘起于瘪赐与大头蛋的电视遭窃，他们急著上天下海四处找寻，终于来到一煎破旅馆，遇到个叫曼迪的老粗。曼迪说他愿付一万元雇他们去洛杉矶“做“了他老婆，色欲薰心的瘪四与大头蛋一听，不禁喜出望外，殊不知此“做“非彼“做“！于是，他们欢天喜地的搭上往洛杉矶的飞机，展开他们的处男航（第一次搭飞机）。但到了洛杉矶，事情并不如他们所想像的，为了追上曼迪的前妻，瘪四与大头蛋始终周旋在两名联邦调查员和一群老人之间。

tmdb-tv-258742.title: 诉讼女王
tmdb-tv-258742.overview: 一群女律师脱离男性主导的事务所，自立门户，开创自己的事业。她们精明干练，心思细腻，处理各种棘手的离婚案件、丑闻秘辛，以及法庭内外不断变化的结盟关系。在金钱至上、爱情如战场的世界里，她们不只是参与者，更是游戏规则的改变者。

tmdb-tv-218347.title: 甜豌豆
tmdb-tv-218347.overview: 莱安农·刘易斯并不令人印象深刻，也很难脱颖而出。她走在街上时，人们不会注意到她。她在工作中升职时总是被忽视，她喜欢的那个男人有承诺问题，她的父亲病得很重。突然间，当她失去控制并变成一个全新的人时，她生活中的一切都发生了巨大变化——一个有信心做任何事情的人。当她拥抱一个新的强大角色时，她的生活永远改变了，但她能保守自己的秘密吗？

tmdb-tv-244447.title: 狩猎娇妻
tmdb-tv-244447.overview: 苏菲离开新英格兰，来到德克萨斯州东部腹地，认识了一位魅力十足的富有名媛并加入了对方的社交圈，而圈内一群主妇们都藏着危险的秘密。很快，她的生活被痴迷、诱惑与谋杀所吞噬。

tmdb-tv-153312.title: 塔尔萨之王
tmdb-tv-153312.overview: 纽约黑手党头目德怀特·曼弗雷迪服刑25年后获释，却被组织放逐至俄克拉何马州塔尔萨。他逐步招募一群意想不到的伙伴，在这座陌生城市建立自己的犯罪帝国。

tmdb-tv-261317.title: 槲寄生谋杀案
tmdb-tv-261317.overview: 《槲寄生谋杀案》是由Hallmark+制作的惊悚犯罪剧集，讲述当圣诞礼品店老板艾米丽·莱恩调查当地一起树木农场的谋杀案时，她的侦探技能受到了考验。尽管山姆·威尔纳警探对艾米丽的感情越来越深，但一块有毒的饼干却将她与犯罪联系起来，而艾米莉神秘的过去也让人怀疑她调查谋杀案的真正动机。

tmdb-tv-256106.title: Homestead: The Series
tmdb-tv-256106.overview: A continuation of the movie Homestead... Amid chaos, ex-Green Beret joins prepper compound; love grows, truths arise, and a community unites.

tmdb-tv-881.title: 我们的日子
tmdb-tv-881.overview: 本剧主要描述两个家庭：荷顿(Hortons)家族和布雷迪(Bradys)家族。 很多其他家族也进入到这个团队，并且偶尔露面。荷顿家族的女家长，Frances Reid从该剧成立以来一直参与演出直到2010年2月3日逝世。 Suzanne Rogers在我们的日子38周年庆生会中，回顾她第一次于1973年出场。 Susan Seaforth Hayes 则是唯一的从开播到现在都还在的角色。

tmdb-tv-107484.title: Mandy
tmdb-tv-107484.overview: Mandy is a woman with dreams. Big dreams. Most of all she dreams of breeding Doberman Pinchers. But there are hurdles to overcome before that dream can become a reality.

tmdb-tv-280880.title: 狂怒
tmdb-tv-280880.overview: 五位女性面对极端情境，激发出她们的愤怒。

tvdb-show-320423.title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
tvdb-show-320423.overview: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

tmdb-tv-155780.title: 蝙蝠交通工具
tmdb-tv-155780.overview: 《蝙蝠交通工具 第一季》围绕着超级蝙蝠车团队展开，讲述了他们在守护高谭市过程中的一系列精彩故事。团队成员包括勇敢的班姆、特技高手小碧、匿踪科技专家红鸟、力量强大的巴夫和飞行能力者飞翼。在蝙蝠计算机比希和机动作业专家阿莫的协助下，他们保护着城市的和平。在这一季中，超级蝙蝠车团队遭遇了众多超级坏蛋带来的麻烦。小丑、企鹅、毒藤女、谜语大师等反派肆意妄为，给城市制造了诸多混乱。小丑偷走奖杯、用气球袭击庄园；企鹅抢夺燃料电池、控制小鸭船捣乱；毒藤女利用植物威胁城市；谜语大师则凭借各种阴谋诡计制造麻烦......面对这些危机，超级蝙蝠车团队从不退缩，他们在危机中成长，在困境中学会合作，在失败中汲取经验，最终不仅能成功解救高谭市，彼此的感情也更加深厚。

imdb-tt38268282.title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
imdb-tt38268282.original_title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
imdb-tt38268282.overview: America, 1890. Johnny Joestar, a genius jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, chases after outlaw Gyro Zeppeli in a tough cross-continent horse race.

tmdb-tv-306118.title: Arafta
tmdb-tv-306118.overview: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart. Suspended between love's salvation and fate's cruelty, Arafta is a saga of passion and payback, where every choice risks turning fire into ashes.

tmdb-tv-328010.title: 恶魔纹章
tmdb-tv-328010.overview:
“哥哥，这里是现实啊！”

　　雪花小学六年级一班的芦原佑马，在游玩世界第一款 VRMMORPG《Actual Magic》时，踏入了游戏与现实融合的“新世界”。正当佑马因无法理解现状而陷入混乱时，班级第一美少女绵卷澄香出现在他面前。但她的容貌已发生近乎悲剧性的异变——那副姿态，简直只能让人联想到游戏里的“怪物”……

　　“这既是游戏，亦是现实。”

tmdb-tv-305245.title: 染血平安夜
tmdb-tv-305245.overview: The series follows the brutal murder of a pregnant woman, her husband, and her young brother on a dark country road. It exposes the subsequent cover-up, the wall of silence kept by dozens of local witnesses who were bound by a blood oath, and the grueling investigation to bring the killers to justice.

tmdb-tv-256711.title: 造雨人
tmdb-tv-256711.overview: 改编自约翰·格里森姆的同名小说。年轻律师鲁迪·贝勒与布鲁瑟·斯通、迪克·希夫莱特联手，在复杂的法律纠纷中挑战强大势力，揭露案件背后的阴谋，在法庭上为委托人争取正义。

tmdb-tv-207484.title: 古战场传奇：吾血之亲
tmdb-tv-207484.overview: 《古战场传奇：吾血之亲》是《古战场传奇》的前传。讲述杰米·弗雷泽和克莱尔·博尚的父母在不同时代的爱情故事。18世纪的苏格兰高地，艾伦与布莱恩冲破家族阻碍相爱；20世纪的欧洲，亨利与朱莉娅因战争相遇。两段跨越时代的爱情，共同揭开弗雷泽家族的过去。

tmdb-tv-314360.title: 雅嘎疑云
tmdb-tv-314360.overview: 改编自凯特·桑德勒创作的同名舞台剧，并重新演绎巴巴雅嘎的民间传说。私家侦探拉普来到一座海滨小镇，调查大型渔业企业继承人亨利·朴的失踪案。随着调查深入，他与当地警探卡森及迷人的大学教授凯瑟琳发生冲突，并逐渐陷入充满神秘嫌疑人、隐秘生活与古老魔法的迷局。

tmdb-tv-387.title: 海绵宝宝
tmdb-tv-387.overview: 海绵宝宝是一块穿着短裤衬衫打领带、暴牙大眼睛的黄色海绵，他生活在太平洋中央一片名为比基尼的海底之下。这里风和日丽，平静祥和，生活无忧无虑。海绵宝宝住在一个菠萝形状的房子里，与之为伴的是他的宠物小蜗（蜗牛）。开朗、纯真的海绵宝宝有许多好朋友，比如乐观单纯的派大星、性格古怪的章鱼哥、自私市侩的蟹老板还有力大无穷的松鼠珊蒂。平时他都在蟹老板的快餐店里打工，闲暇时就和好朋友们四处玩乐。这群性格各异的家伙们凑在一起，可真是闹出不少的笑话……本片为美国最受欢迎的电视系列动画之一，在 2003~2009 年期间，曾经 7 年当选美国儿童选择奖最受欢迎的动画片。

tmdb-tv-287296.title: Honey
tmdb-tv-287296.overview: Honey goes deep undercover in 1980s East Berlin to explore a shadowy world of counter espionage and risky but irresistible relations. East Berlin, 1982. Martha, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois. The risk of being garrotted or incarcerated is nothing compared to the horrifying ordeal of falling in love. Allowing yourself to be vulnerable and bearing your heart and soul? She'd rather have her fingernails ripped off.

tvdb-show-464466.title: I Kill The Bear
tvdb-show-464466.overview: I Kill The Bear is a comedy about a family of bear wranglers for film sets, and why – after 100 years – they've decided to make this film their last.

tmdb-tv-45140.title: 少年泰坦出击
tmdb-tv-45140.overview:
本剧是 DC 经典动画《少年泰坦》的衍生喜剧作品。与前作偏重严肃动作的风格截然不同，本剧聚焦于罗宾（Robin）、星火（Starfire）、钢骨（Cyborg）、渡鸦（Raven）和野兽男孩（Beast Boy）这五位少年超级英雄在“不拯救世界”时的日常生活。

没有了成年人的监督，这些性格各异的青春期英雄们同住在泰坦塔里，闹出了各种啼笑皆非的笑话。从为了争夺电视遥控器而大打出手、疯狂迷恋某种垃圾食品，到应对各种奇葩的超级反派，他们的日常生活中充满了无厘头的幽默、自我恶搞以及对流行文化的疯狂致敬。这是一部轻松、跳脱且极具娱乐性的超级英雄日常喜剧。

tmdb-tv-146339.title: 大王饶命
tmdb-tv-146339.overview: 灵气复苏的时代，寂静生活碎掉了，仿佛雷霆贯穿长空，电光直射天心，雨沙沙地落下。凡逆我们的终将离去，这就是法则。高中生吕树在一场车祸中改变人生，当灵气复苏时代来袭，他要做这时代的领跑者。物竞天择，胜者为王。这是一个吕树依靠毒鸡汤成为大魔王的故事。

tmdb-tv-285899.title: 转生后的大圣女，极力隐瞒圣女的身份
tmdb-tv-285899.original_title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
tmdb-tv-285899.overview: 被认为「没有使剑的才能」的骑士家的少女·菲亚。她在濒死之际，回想起自己前世是拥有规格外能力的「大圣女」，并且使最强的魔物·黑龙成为她的从魔。但是回想起在前世魔王的右腕曾威胁她说「若是依旧作为圣女转生那我依旧会继续杀你」，菲亚决定一边隐藏大圣女的力量一边以骑士为目标，可是却引发了众多骚动！？

tmdb-tv-106449.title: 凡人修仙传
tmdb-tv-106449.original_title: Fanren Xiu Xian Chuan Zhi Fanren Feng Qi Tian Nan
tmdb-tv-106449.overview: 看机智的凡人小子韩立如何稳健发展、步步为营，战魔道、夺至宝、驰骋星海、快意恩仇，成为纵横三界的强者。他日仙界重相逢，一声道友尽沧桑。

imdb-tt41492493.title: The Witch Farm
imdb-tt41492493.overview: South Wales, 1989. Bill and Liz Rich leave London for Heol Fanog, a remote modern farmhouse in the foothills of the Brecon Beacons, determined to make a fresh start. At first, the isolation feels like freedom. But when, in the midst of a traumatic home birth, Liz becomes convinced she's seen a ghostly figure in the bedroom they start to feel increasingly afraid…What follows is a steady escalation of the chillingly uncanny - unexplained disturbances and an unsettling sense that they are not alone. As Bill and Liz begin to investigate, the house draws them deeper into a history that refuses to stay buried. And as the land yields its secrets, so too does their marriage - testing the limits of trust, belief, and what they're willing to deny in order to survive.

imdb-tt33406999.title: Get Jiro
imdb-tt33406999.overview: In a future Los Angeles controlled by elite chefs, a sushi master named Jiro gets embroiled in a culinary conflict, seeking vengeance through his cooking skills amidst the cutthroat restaurant scene.

imdb-tt27535062.title: City of God: The Fight Rages On
imdb-tt27535062.original_title: City of God: The Fight Rages On
imdb-tt27535062.overview: City of God: The Fight Rages On takes place two decades after the events of the highly acclaimed film "City of God." City of God: The Fight Rages On is an adapted continuation of the literary work by Paulo Lins, and will follow the story of its characters, starting with the work of the photographer Buscapé. Set in the early 2000s, the series includes excerpts from the film as flashbacks to reconstruct the protagonists' memories.

tvdb-show-478752.title: Overgeared
tvdb-show-478752.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

imdb-tt31131310.title: Mission: Yozakura Family
imdb-tt31131310.overview: High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

tvdb-show-459942.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
tvdb-show-459942.original_title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
tvdb-show-459942.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

tvmaze-episode-3772779.title: Fool in Love
tvmaze-episode-3772779.overview: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

imdb-tt32062031.title: Sram
imdb-tt32062031.overview: Following the lives of teenagers that attend high school, everyday issues of teenage life, such as friendships, romantic relationships and mental health.Croatian remake of the Norwegian series Skam

tvmaze-episode-3822819.title: Taming the Husband
tvmaze-episode-3822819.overview: Jin Bao Zhu, the spirited daughter of a butcher, has always harbored simple, materialistic dreams of wealth and comfort. Desperate to escape her oppressive family life, she volunteers to enter a prestigious canal transport family as the concubine of their son, Xie Yan. However, her dreams of luxury quickly shatter: while Xie Yan was once a brilliant prodigy, he has been left disabled and disgraced by a tragic accident. Xie Yan has become bitter and self-destructive and resents Bao Zhu, who he feels has been forced upon him. The marriage gets off to a rough start, as Xie Yan and Bao Zhu are constantly fighting. But as they navigate the treacherous political schemes surrounding the canal transport industry and fend off ambitious relatives, their mutual animosity slowly transforms. Can they find a way to work together to save their crumbling family legacy and their marriage?

tmdb-tv-290856.title: Marshals
tmdb-tv-290856.overview: Marshals stars Luke Grimes reprising his role as Kayce Dutton. With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana. Kayce and his teammates - Pete Calvin, Belle Skinner, Andrea Cruz and Miles Kittle - must balance the high psychological cost of serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence with their duty to their families, which for Kayce includes his son Tate and his confidants Thomas Rainwater and Mo from the Broken Rock reservation.

tmdb-tv-456.title: The Simpsons
tmdb-tv-456.overview: The Simpsons is the longest running scripted show in US television history. It captures the adventures of Homer, Marge, Maggie, Bart and Lisa who are living in a fictional town called Springfield.

tmdb-tv-211288.title: Tracker
tmdb-tv-211288.overview: Tracker features lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw, who roams the country as a "reward seeker," using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement to solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

tmdb-tv-253372.title: The Institute
tmdb-tv-253372.overview: When 12-year-old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won't last, as his story and Luke's are destined to collide.

tmdb-tv-81723.title: The Gilded Age
tmdb-tv-81723.overview: The American Gilded Age was a period of immense economic change, of huge fortunes made and lost, and the rise of disparity between old money and new.Against this backdrop of change, the story begins in 1882 — introducing young Marian Brook, the orphaned daughter of a Union general, who moves into the New York City home of her thoroughly old money aunts Agnes van Rhijn and Ada Brook. Accompanied by Peggy Scott, an accomplished African-American woman, Marian inadvertently becomes enmeshed in a social war between one of her aunts, a scion of the old money set, and her stupendously rich neighbors, a ruthless railroad tycoon and his ambitious wife, George and Bertha Russell.In this exciting new world that is on the brink of the modern age, will Marian follow the established rules of society, or forge her own path?

imdb-tt8270592.title: Miss Scarlet
imdb-tt8270592.overview: When Eliza's father dies, he leaves her penniless in a time where marriage is the only option for financial security. But the headstrong Eliza has an ace up her bonnet - her father's business, a detective agency. But it's Victorian London and, to operate in this man's world, she needs a partner.Step forward consummate rogue Detective Inspector William Wellington of Scotland Yard, aka "The Duke".Eliza and Duke strike up a fiery relationship as they team up to solve puzzling crimes in the murkiest depths of 1880s London.

imdb-tt21376524.title: Animal Control
imdb-tt21376524.overview: Animal Control is a workplace comedy following a group of Animal Control workers whose lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not.

imdb-tt1094229.title: Heartland
imdb-tt1094229.overview: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

imdb-tt15791752.title: Grimsburg
imdb-tt15791752.overview: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack - his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute will follow every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know.

imdb-tt23469464.title: Universal Basic Guys
imdb-tt23469464.overview: In Universal Basic Guys brothers Mark and Hank Hoagies suddenly find themselves with no jobs when the Glantontown Hot Dog factory switches over to automation. Lucky for them, the town started a radical Universal Basic Income pilot program, giving all residents of Glantontown $3,000 per month with no strings attached. Now, Mark, Hank and the rest of their local buddies are once again kids in the summertime, overflowing with the perilous combo of free time and stupid ideas. This is a show about men trying to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

imdb-tt7491982.title: FBI
imdb-tt7491982.overview: FBI is a fast-paced drama about the inner workings of the New York Field Office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. These first-class agents, including Special Agent Maggie Bell and her partner, Special Agent Omar Adom 'OA' Zidan, bring all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep New York and the country safe.

imdb-tt35515227.title: CIA
imdb-tt35515227.overview: CIA centers on two unlikely partners — a fast-talking, rule-breaking loose cannon CIA case officer, and a by-the-book, seasoned and smart FBI agent who believes in the rule of law. When this odd couple are assigned to work out of CIA's New York Station, they must learn to work together to investigate cases and criminals posing threats on U.S. soil, finding that their differences may actually be their strength.

imdb-tt37433759.title: Trinity
imdb-tt37433759.overview: A heroic female naval officer becomes involved with the outwardly charismatic secretary of defense, only to discover he may be at the heart of a dangerous conspiracy.

imdb-tt0056758.title: General Hospital
imdb-tt0056758.overview: General Hospital, which celebrated its golden anniversary on April 1, 2013, continues its tradition of passion, intrigue and adventure that takes place in the fictional town of Port Charles in upstate New York. The glamour and excitement of those who have come to find their destinies in this familiar seaport town intertwine with the lives, loves and fortunes of beloved, well-known faces. As always, love, danger and mind blowing plot twists continue to abound on General Hospital with contemporary storylines and unforgettable characters.

tvmaze-episode-3823003.title: Family Guy Hulu Exclusives
tvmaze-episode-3823003.overview: A series of exclusive 'Family Guy' specials that air only on Hulu.

imdb-tt32125269.title: Beyond the Gates
imdb-tt32125269.overview: Beyond the Gates is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. Here you'll find a posh gated community with winding tree-lined streets and luxurious mansions to call home. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where our characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life … and some with more grace than others.

tvdb-show-465335.title: Dead Ahead
tvdb-show-465335.overview: A high-powered Māori lawyer accidentally unleashes her chaotic tūpuna (ancestors), forcing the living and the dead to navigate their shared legacy.

imdb-tt5676412.title: Sin Senos Sí Hay Paraíso
imdb-tt5676412.overview: Sin Senos Si Hay Paraiso season two picks up after older Catalina (Carmen Villalobos), who everyone believed to be dead for many years, returns. With the help and support of secret agents, Catalina, now an anti-narcotics agent herself, captures and extradites La Diabla to the United States. La Diabla manages to evade authorities and flees to Colombia. Now, Catalina and La Diabla, once inseparable friends, face off as mortal enemies.

mal-63382.overview:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

mal-64340.title: 装备我最强
mal-64340.overview:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Tempal: Item no Chikara is streaming a week in advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video and Crunchyroll beginning September 27th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on October 2nd, 2026.

mal-63754.title: 冷淡的佐藤同学只对我撒娇
mal-63754.original_title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
mal-63754.english_title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
mal-63754.overview:
Sato-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer.

Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat!

Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

mal-61967.title: ブラッククローバー 第2期
mal-61967.overview:
As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-63431.title: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。　～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
mal-63431.original_title: Tsuihou Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka Suru.: Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
mal-63431.english_title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
mal-63431.overview:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.
Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.
The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.
Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.
This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!
(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)

mal-63409.title: 你好，我是受心上人所托来做恋爱药的魔女。
mal-63409.original_title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.
mal-63409.english_title: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
mal-63409.overview:
“Make me a love potion.”

And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

(Source: Yen Press)

mal-61987.title: 药屋少女的呢喃 第三季
mal-61987.overview:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district.

One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature.

Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation."

To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again.

From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-63712.title: 转生哥布林有问题吗？
mal-63712.english_title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
mal-63712.overview:
Office worker Akira Yagami’s altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira’s newfound powers let him defy the species’ normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

(Source: Yen Press)
